title: 我梦见你们了。
content_zh:
新书发布已经一个星期了，仔细看了兄弟们的所有评论，有时候想笑，有时候想哭，更多的时候有一种想要恋爱的冲动。
别怀疑，我为了走新路想的快要发疯了，现在脑子不合适，这种事大概率能干的出来，如果你们不想跟一个秃头胖子谈恋爱，就早点把月票啦，推荐票之类的东西统统早点给我，了了我的思念之情。
如果兄弟姐妹们继续把月票，推荐票这些危险的东西放在手上，只会引起我无限的思念，我可能会在梦里梦见你，在那个世界里，我是幻想之王……想想你们的下场吧……而且，我很会编皮鞭，用魔法编搓弄出来的皮鞭，稍微挥动一下，就会有咻咻的破风声。
没错，我不装了，以上就是威胁，如果不想在梦里跟我同床共枕，就早点吧那些东西给我！
反正，你们那么年轻，那么帅气，那么好看，怎么看都是我占便宜。
另外，告诉我亲爱的兄弟姐妹们，你们对于新书的猜测是错的，什么程咬金的儿子，什么秦琼的儿子，什么牛进达，不可能，统统不可能。
这一次我不会抄书评写作，绝对不会再犯《汉乡》书中被你们裹挟改剧情的错误，就是一马平川的向前写，给兄弟姐妹们一个痛痛快快的大唐。
另外，我必须感谢一下棠棠的白银盟，感谢桐棠白银盟，感谢天海祥云盟主，猪三不盟主，书友20190327092104156盟主，江左辰盟主，书友20220610194129583盟主，山阳笛声盟主，历史系之狼盟主，书友20171226153543288盟主。
断鴻盟主，雨露花浓盟主这两个就不感谢了，一个是我的版主，一个是我老婆，都是我的老水军了，没必要感谢。

content_en:
It has been a week since the new book was released. I read all the comments from the brothers carefully. Sometimes I want to laugh, sometimes I want to cry, and more often I feel the urge to fall in love.
Don’t doubt it, I’m going crazy thinking about taking a new path. Now that my brain is not in the right place, there is a high probability that I can do this kind of thing. If you don’t want to fall in love with a bald fat man, you should give me your monthly tickets, recommendation tickets and other things as soon as possible to make me miss you.
If brothers and sisters continue to put dangerous things like monthly tickets and recommendation tickets in their hands, it will only arouse my endless longing. I may dream about you in my dreams. In that world, I am the king of fantasy... Think about your fate... Moreover, I am good at braiding whips. The whips made by magic braiding will make a whistling sound when I wave it a little.
That's right, I won't pretend anymore. The above is a threat. If you don't want to sleep with me in your dreams, just give me those things as soon as possible!
Anyway, you are so young, so handsome, so good-looking, no matter what, I am taking advantage of you.
In addition, tell my dear brothers and sisters that your guesses about the new book are wrong. It is impossible, not possible, about Cheng Yaojin’s son, Qin Qiong’s son, or Niu Jinda.
This time I will not copy the book reviews and I will definitely not make the same mistake in "Hanxiang" that you coerced into changing the plot. I will just move forward and give my brothers and sisters a happy Tang Dynasty.
In addition, I must thank Tangtang’s Baiyin Alliance, thank Tongtang Baiyin Alliance, thank Tianhai Xiangyun Alliance Leader, Zhu Sanbu Alliance Leader, Book Friends 20190327092104156 Alliance Leader, Jiang Leader Zuo Chen, leader of Book Friends 20220610194129583, leader of Shanyang Flute Leader, leader of Wolf of History Department, leader of Book Friends 20171226153543288.
